channel.title: One Caribbean Television - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from One Caribbean Television (onecaribbeantelevision.com)

item.title: White House Launches TrumpRx.gov, Several Brand Name Drugs Set for Steep Discounts
item.description: The Trump administration says it has a new tool to lower high drug prices. TrumpRx.gov was launched this week and offers discounts on 40 of the most popular and expensive branded medications in the country.

item.title: Deadline for Homeland Security Funding Approaches
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - Time is running out for congressional members to fund the Department of Homeland Security. Members have until the end of the week to move forward with funding. Democrats are still demanding additional reforms for ICE.

item.title: Democrats Blast White House Counterproposal for DHS Funding, ICE Reforms as Deadline Approaches
item.description: Democrats are slamming a counterproposal they received from the White House last night, as negotiations over Immigration and Customs Enforcement reforms and DHS funding approach a critical deadline.

item.title: Senate Hearing Examines Impact of FCC Broadcast Ownership Rule on Local Journalism, Market Competition
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - In a Senate Commerce hearing, Senators looked at the changes to the American media landscape, focusing on a rule on broadcast ownership. The hearing comes at a time where a major broadcast group is looking to solidify a deal that could allow their broadcast company to reach 80 percent of TV households. Broadcasters shared the pros and cons of how changing that FCC rule could impact local journalism.

item.title: Inspired by ‘Walk for Peace’, People Welcome Texas Monks’ Journey to D.C.
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - Walking 2,300 miles from Fort Worth, Texas to Washington, D.C., these Buddhist monks have captivated the nation. Their mission is simple: to advocate for peace. It’s a message that’s resonated across the country, especially here in D.C., where it’s the center of political discord.

item.title: Heated DOJ Oversight Hearing Focuses on Epstein Files, Redactions
item.description: It was a heated oversight hearing for the Justice Department and Attorney General Pam Bondi on Capitol Hill. Lawmakers pressed Bondi over delays in releasing the Epstein files and redactions within them.

item.title: House Passed Trump-backed Elections Bill, Heads to Senate
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - The Republican-controlled House passed a sweeping elections bill on Wednesday. The SAVE America Act tightens voter registration standards but Democrats are calling it “Jim Crow 2.0". Just one Democrat voted with House Republicans to advance the measure.

item.title: Republican-Controlled House Rebels Against Trump’s Canada Tariffs in Bipartisan Vote
item.description: Wednesday evening, the Republican-controlled House took a rare step, voting to rein in a key part of President Trump’s trade agenda — zeroing in on tariffs he slapped on Canadian imports over the past year.

item.title: Global Leaders, Diplomats Discuss Shared Challenges at Munich Security Conference
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - World leaders, diplomats and some US congressional members made their way to Germany for the Munich Security Conference. Leaders will focus on the most pressing issues facing the world. From the war in Ukraine, to the future of NATO, and even the changes in US foreign policy.

item.title: Partial Shutdown Looms as DHS Funding Approaches Deadline
item.description: While the rest of the federal government is funded through September, DHS funding remains in limbo. Funding for the department is set to expire Friday night. If it does, it will be the third shutdown of President Trump’s second term.
